name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Republican Strategy to Salvage the Midterms
changes.summary: The right wing is scrambling for wins in the elections as Democrats lead in the polls.

changes.title: Democrats Worry About Tight Midterm Races in Maine, Michigan and Minnesota
changes.summary: Despite hopes for a blue wave, Democratic candidates in Minnesota, Maine and Michigan are facing local political headwinds and have struggled to open up clear daylight in the polls.

changes.title: An accounting of Trump's promised payouts and questions they raise
changes.summary: President Trump is cutting checks to Americans and promising more with less than three weeks left in a midterm cycle largely focused on affordability. Trump argues they're refunds for excessive healthcare costs and promised economic dividends that only his party can deliver. Democrats contend he's trying to bribe citiz.

changes.title: Senators Demand Investigation Into Ukraine Satellite Disruption
changes.summary: Republicans joined Democrats in calling on the Pentagon’s inspector general to look into whether the Trump administration was responsible for the interruption.

changes.title: Inflation Data Shows Prices Are Up, Worrying Republicans Ahead of the Midterms
changes.summary: The newest inflation report gave Democrats a chance to tie pain at the pump to President Trump’s decisions.

changes.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
changes.summary: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms. (Image credit: Saul Loeb).

changes.title: Kamala Harris to Campaign for Democrats in Mississippi, New Hampshire and Wisconsin Ahead of Midterms
changes.summary: Former Vice President Kamala Harris will also rally for Democratic candidates in Georgia and Nevada.

changes.title: Democratic and GOP strategists on how Trump's unpopularity is shaping the midterms
changes.summary: The latest polling for the upcoming midterms shows a tilt in Democrats' favor. For an inside view of the final weeks of the campaign, Geoff Bennett spoke with Democratic strategist Mo Elleithee and Republican strategist Doug Heye.

changes.title: He Would Be Florida’s First Black Governor. Can He Sway Black Voters?
changes.summary: Byron Donalds, the Republican nominee for governor, is working to win over Black voters who usually support Democrats as his party girds for the possibility of low turnout.

changes.title: Lin-Manuel Miranda rallies Latino voters for Democratic candidates ahead of midterms
changes.summary: Democrats' path to flipping the House could come down to their ability to win back Latino voters. NBC News' Liz Kreutz traveled with Broadway icon Lin-Manuel Miranda, who is hitting the campaign trail to boost Democratic congressional candidates in competitive swing districts.
